title: v4.1.0 · 上游契约策展与跨平台修复
highlights: Curate engineering, Lark, AKS and Neon contracts while preserving local authorization overlays
Replace fictional AKS assessment calls with discovered metadata reads and tested privacy projection
Fix macOS HTML report path aliases without allowing final-file symlinks
Retain Live Panel MIT code and full notices; replace three third-party illustration configs with an original simulated example
Preserve all 294 public skill entry points and provenance for the reviewed release scope
release_gates: Exact PR head and merged-main Repository Validation, provenance and CodeQL pass
Zero open Code Scanning alerts on main before publishing
Complete repository validation, installer matrix and generator idempotence pass
Downloaded source/npm archives, manifest and SHA256SUMS match the exact merged-main commit

validation_boundaries.upstream: Six source groups reviewed; other monitor-only changes remain queued and are not described as synchronized.
validation_boundaries.licensing: Live Panel is a manually maintained fixed MIT code snapshot with the full upstream notice; non-original illustration configs are excluded. GitHub NOASSERTION is preserved, not overridden.
validation_boundaries.runtime: Static checks and isolated local CLI/projection tests do not certify live Lark, Azure, Neon, X, Hermes or production behavior.
validation_boundaries.security: Zero open Code Scanning alerts describes the configured scanner results, not a proof that every vulnerability is absent.

compatibility_notes: Live Panel examples/codex-agents, examples/airbnb and examples/agent-architecture are no longer distributed; use examples/service-pipeline/config.json or a user-owned configuration
Updated Slides schema uses gapWidth and overlap instead of the former gap field
Canonical skill names and the installer CLI remain unchanged
